scope: Source comparison of named non-AI KidBright generations and selected manufacturer-documented compatible derivatives. Catalog presence is not executable firmware support, physical validation, or a complete census of community boards.

unresolved_labels.label: KidBright V1.0
unresolved_labels.reason: No separate revision-labelled V1.0 hardware source was established; document/IDE version 1.0 is not proof of a board revision.

unresolved_labels.label: KidBright V1.5 iA / KidBright iA
unresolved_labels.reason: Informal or historical labels must be checked against INEX product name, PCB silkscreen and fitted accelerometer; they do not establish a separate PCB or KXTJ3 variant.

unresolved_labels.label: KidBright iP
unresolved_labels.reason: Short form requires INEX/PCB confirmation; canonical manufacturer product name is KidBright32iP.

unresolved_labels.label: KidBright32 V1.6 USB-C
unresolved_labels.reason: Main product specifies Micro USB; kit wording mentions Micro USB or USB-C in some versions without a distinct PCB identifier. Do not invent a second executable profile.

boards.label: KidBright V2016 (historical ESP8266 generation)
boards.manufacturer: NECTEC project; exact manufacturing revision unconfirmed

peripherals.name: programming
peripherals.detail: Project history identifies ESP8266 and smartphone-app programming for the first generation.

unknowns: Exact PCB revision, pinout, bootloader, memory and deployed firmware are not validated.
conflicts: Historical project development and trial dates do not establish a separate V1.0 PCB.
notes: No ESP32 ESP-IDF recipe or flash target is assigned. ESP8266 is catalog information only.

boards.label: KidBright V1.0 (unresolved historical board label)
unknowns: A separate hardware product/revision, MCU and pinout have not been established from a primary source.
conflicts: The old KB labels V1.0 as a 2017 ESP8266 release; primary history confirms the V2016 ESP8266 generation but not that separate revision name.
notes: Do not merge with V2016 or treat software/document version 1.0 as hardware evidence.

boards.label: KidBright32 V1.1

peripherals.name: usb_serial_driver
peripherals.detail: Official download index assigns the Cypress driver to hardware versions 1.1 and 1.2.

unknowns: Exact revision-labelled schematic, MCU module, pin/address map and SDK build are not validated in this catalog.
conflicts: The common ESP32 pin table in the old KB is not used as per-revision proof.
notes: A software driver listing confirms a board label, not every peripheral or executable profile.

boards.label: KidBright32 V1.2

peripherals.name: usb_serial_driver
peripherals.detail: Official download index assigns the Cypress driver to hardware versions 1.1 and 1.2.

unknowns: Exact schematic changes from V1.1, MCU module, pin/address map and SDK build remain unverified.
conflicts: Sharing a USB driver is not evidence that every V1.1/V1.2 GPIO or peripheral is identical.

boards.label: KidBright32 V1.3

peripherals.name: display
peripherals.detail: Two red 8x8 modules form a 16x8 matrix driven by HT16K33 on SDA0/SCL0; reference address 0x70.

peripherals.name: temperature
peripherals.detail: LM73 shares SDA1/SCL1 with the RTC. Desktop header lists candidate addresses 0x49 and 0x4D; the existing recipe selects 0x4D.

peripherals.name: rtc
peripherals.detail: Schematic names MCP79411-I/SN on SDA1/SCL1; reference runtime uses the MCP7940-family RTC address 0x6F.

peripherals.name: light
peripherals.detail: Onboard LDR voltage network feeds SENSOR_VP/GPIO36; raw readings require the matching divider/polarity contract.

peripherals.name: buttons_audio_usb
peripherals.detail: Two user buttons, transistor-driven buzzer, FT231XQ USB-UART bridge and switched USB-A output.

unknowns: Physical-board behavior, exact LM73 ordering code/address and all peripheral combinations are not validated.
conflicts: The old KB names FT232RL, but the revision-labelled schematic specifies FT231XQ.
RTC belongs to SDA1/SCL1 in this schematic, not the display bus SDA0/SCL0.
notes: Pilot is peripheral-scoped; presence of documented matrix/RTC/USB pins does not certify all blocks or recipes. Hardware was not flashed by this catalog audit.

boards.label: KidBright32 V1.4
boards.manufacturer: Gravitech Thai product family; exact revision supplier unconfirmed
unknowns: Exact V1.4 MCU module, USB bridge, LED count, schematic and GPIO differences are not validated.
conflicts: Manufacturer upward-compatibility wording for V1.6 does not prove V1.4 uses an identical pin map or runtime.
notes: The official V1.6 product acknowledges V1.4 as a predecessor; no executable V1.4 profile is inferred.

boards.label: KidBright32 V1.5 (revision not specified)

peripherals.name: display_sensors_io
peripherals.detail: Provided V1.5 design contains HT16K33, LM73, MCP79411 RTC, LDR, two buttons, buzzer, analog input paths and servo connectors.

peripherals.name: i2c_layout
peripherals.detail: In the provided design HT16K33 uses SDA0/SCL0; LM73 and RTC use SDA1/SCL1.

peripherals.name: usb_serial
peripherals.detail: The provided design labels FT231XQ, not CP2102.

unknowns: The user's physical PCB, exact manufacturing revision and relationship between design REV3 and filename Rev3_1 remain unconfirmed.
conflicts: A generic V1.5 label cannot select Rev3.1, Rev3.1G or an INEX i-series profile automatically.
Old KB assertions that all V1.5 boards use CP2102 or cannot accept analog IN1-IN4 do not match this design.
notes: Pins describe the provided design only; they are not a universal V1.5 wiring contract.

boards.label: KidBright32 V1.5 Rev3.1 (existing scoped pilot)

peripherals.name: existing_pilot_scope
peripherals.detail: Existing profile supplies only the S1/buzzer/LM73 contract and recorded ESP32 software build; the exact physical revision identity is not certified.

unknowns: The provided V1.5 filename says Rev3_1 but its schematic title block says REV3; exact Rev3.1 PCB equivalence requires confirmation.
No physical-board measurements or complete peripheral build matrix are recorded.
conflicts: Existing executable profile is not proof of every schematic-derived V1.5 pin or extension.
notes: Retain the prior scoped profile; do not automatically enable new matrix, RTC, motor or expansion recipes for it.

boards.label: KidBright32 V1.5 Rev3.1G (unverified revision label)
unknowns: A primary revision-labelled schematic, manufacturer attribution, target and changes from Rev3.1 have not been established.
conflicts: The old KB equates Rev3.1G with Rev3.1 while also giving inconsistent switch/sensor claims.
notes: Keep this label visible for comparison; never resolve it silently to Rev3.1 or V1.6.

boards.label: INEX KidBright32i / V1.5i

peripherals.name: usb_rtc
peripherals.detail: INEX describes the green KidBright32i predecessor as using USB-C, a USB status LED and an updated RTC/EEPROM arrangement.

unknowns: Exact green-board PCB revision, MCU module, sensor BOM, switch/servo wiring and complete schematic are not validated here.
conflicts: An alias supported by the manufacturer does not make i, iA and iP the same PCB.
notes: Manufacturer software index explicitly pairs KidBright32i with KidBright32 V1.5i; bare i is an ambiguous shorthand without INEX confirmation.

boards.label: INEX KidBright32iA

peripherals.name: display_buttons_audio_rtc
peripherals.detail: 16x8 red matrix, two user buttons, piezo buzzer and battery-backed RTC.

peripherals.name: sensors_usb
peripherals.detail: Current manufacturer product specifies LDR, I2C temperature sensing, USB-C and an accelerometer supported by iA-MC3479.

peripherals.name: expansion
peripherals.detail: JST input/output connectors, I2C0 breakout and I2C1 KB CHAIN connector.

unknowns: Exact PCB/BOM revision, accelerometer address, S1/S2 GPIO, temperature chip/address, I2C bus GPIO and a peripheral-tested native ESP-IDF profile remain unvalidated.
User report has no attached build log, serial trace or measured timings.
conflicts: Old KB combines KXTJ3-1057 and phototransistor claims under iA; current INEX product states iA-MC3479 and LDR. Do not silently choose a sensor driver from the old table.
notes: User reports basic Hello/Heartbeat runtime success on iA; this does not certify any matrix, sound, button, sensor, radio or servo behavior.
Provided product diagram adds individually sourced light/buzzer/USB/servo pin labels; no executable profile is inferred.

user_reported_validation.scope: Hello/Heartbeat basic runtime and serial output only; no peripheral access in the supplied main.c.

boards.label: INEX KidBright32iP

peripherals.name: display_buttons_audio_rtc
peripherals.detail: 16x8 red matrix, two user buttons, buzzer and battery-backed RTC.

peripherals.name: light_usb_servo
peripherals.detail: Phototransistor light sensing, USB-C, power indicators and two externally powered servo connectors.

peripherals.name: temperature_rtc_usb
peripherals.detail: Rev.2021.04.01 schematic names LM73-1, MCP79411 RTC and FT231XS USB-UART; temperature and RTC use SDA1/SCL1.

unknowns: The physical PCB must still be matched to the published Rev.2021.04.01 design; actual sensor addresses, power arrangements and native ESP-IDF build remain unvalidated.
conflicts: INEX introduction prose names LM75, but its revision-labelled schematic names LM73-1; use the identified PCB/BOM rather than prose alone.
S2 is GPIO14 and servo channel 2 is GPIO17 in this schematic; those names must not be conflated.
notes: Individually documented pins do not supply a tested iP firmware profile. Do not replace this board with the V1.3/Rev3.1 pilot merely because its MCU is ESP32.

2026-10-19 update: user supplied complete ESP-IDF C for A-Z right-to-left matrix scrolling and reported a physical iP pass. Source: sensor_examples/kidbright32ip_matrix_az_user_passed.c. This is user-reported display-only evidence, not agent-executed hardware/build verification or a deterministic profile. PCB revision and SDK version remain unknown.

boards.label: Gravitech KidBright32 V1.6

peripherals.name: matrix_io_sensors
peripherals.detail: 16x8 matrix, light and temperature sensors, buzzer, two buttons, RTC and USB power output.

peripherals.name: motion_rgb_usb
peripherals.detail: MPU-6050 six-axis motion sensing and six independently controlled Gerora RGB LEDs; main product specifies Micro USB.

unknowns: Exact PCB variant, S2 GPIO, RGB data pin/order, IMU address, full bus map and ESP-IDF profile are unvalidated.
conflicts: Old KB universally claims USB-C for V1.6; the main manufacturer product specifies Micro USB, while kit wording allows some USB-C versions without PCB identifiers.
notes: Manufacturer upward compatibility is a product claim, not evidence of byte-exact behavior or automatic ESP-IDF pin equivalence.

boards.label: Gravitech KidBright Lite V1.1

peripherals.name: core_io
peripherals.detail: Two red 8x8 matrices, light and temperature sensing, two user buttons, buzzer, Chain connector and switched USB-A output.

peripherals.name: motion_rgb_usb
peripherals.detail: LSM6DS3TR-C accelerometer/gyroscope, four Gerora RGB LEDs and USB-C.

unknowns: Exact schematic, temperature/RTC implementation, sensor addresses, RGB wiring and native ESP-IDF build remain unvalidated.
conflicts: Lite V1.1 is not KidBright32 V1.1; LSM6DS3TR-C and four RGB LEDs differ from V1.6 MPU-6050/six LEDs.
notes: Product identity is confirmed; no executable profile is inferred from KidBright IDE compatibility.

boards.label: INEX OpenKB (compatible derivative)

peripherals.name: matrix_sensors_audio
peripherals.detail: 16x8 matrix, LDR, I2C temperature sensor, two buttons and piezo buzzer.

peripherals.name: rtc_usb_expansion
peripherals.detail: Supercapacitor-backed RTC, Micro USB, ten JST I/O connectors and I2C1 extension connectors.

unknowns: Exact schematic, complete onboard GPIO ownership, RTC/temperature chips and native ESP-IDF profile are unvalidated.
conflicts: OpenKB is a separately documented INEX derivative, not a revision alias of KidBright32i or V1.5.
notes: Compare as a derivative; manufacturer plugin support does not provide an app-native ESP-IDF port.

boards.label: Maker Asia KB32-FT (compatible derivative)

peripherals.name: display
peripherals.detail: ST7735 0.96-inch 80x160 color TFT with a KidBright LED-matrix emulation mode; it is not an onboard HT16K33 matrix.

peripherals.name: sensors_connectors
peripherals.detail: Motion, light, temperature, RTC and buzzer are advertised; Feather-style connectors and a breakout provide the documented compatibility layer.

unknowns: Exact schematic/BOM, compatibility-layer firmware, pin resource ownership and this app's native ESP-IDF deployment remain unvalidated.
conflicts: TFT emulation cannot be replaced by writing HT16K33 RAM solely because KidBright programs are advertised as compatible.
notes: Manufacturer lists ESP-IDF among available tools, but this repository has no validated KB32-FT recipe or profile.
